brief:
Gaza's Health Ministry reported one death and 30 injuries across the territory's hospitals over the past 24 hours on Thursday, attributing the casualties to ongoing Israeli military operations. The ministry did not provide further details on the circumstances of the incidents or their locations within the enclave.

The toll adds to the cumulative Palestinian death count since a ceasefire began, Shehab Wire reported. Gaza's health system has faced severe strain throughout the conflict, with repeated damage to medical infrastructure limiting treatment capacity and forcing hospitals to operate under acute resource constraints. The ministry regularly publishes casualty figures based on reports from medical facilities across the territory.
